definitions.hard: A <= ref A and AD <= ref AD, on every retained search state and every recorded result; never traded
definitions.strict: within hard limits, G <= ref G and GD <= ref GD, at least one strictly smaller
definitions.tradeoff: within hard limits, a permitted move listed under the target's 'tradeoffs'; never called dominating
definitions.frontier: every verified circuit within hard limits that is Pareto-minimal in (G, GD) for that target; also kept: Pareto in (A, AD, G, GD)
definitions.note: min_gate_gain_for_depth_cost and max_gate_cost_for_depth_gain are the coordinator's provisional reading of 'substantial' and 'modest'; the user may change them; the ledger recomputes from this file
